title: Whole-diagram transport of specified comparison data
statement: For two open compactification diagrams G,H and an isomorphism I of their entire diagrams, and specified square packets Q,R for G,H and T,T' for I's two support-transport diagrams, define diagram-comparison data as follows. At the integral stage use the four actual corner pullbacks as the vertex functors between the two operation squares. The support comparisons are exactly the two ordered exchange arrows of T and T'; the pullback comparisons are the framework whole-system square compositors and the PBC ordinary-square/quotient-unit-normalized compositors. At raw rational stages use compatible natural-isomorphism families between these composites of the existing framework/PBC operation systems; every component is the localization of the corresponding integral map. The mixed beta equations retain all coefficient associators and repeated stages. The finite and common-stage diagram comparisons are these finite components and their actual pair-functor descents, with the prescribed composition isomorphisms. No commutation or naturality theorem is built into this definition: those are equations of actual exchange transformations in the owning comparison theorem. No corner isomorphism is required to be k-linear. The constituent notions are [def-zl-compactification-open-diagram], [def-zl-framework-pbc-open-comparison-data], [def-cbc-normalized-coefficient-families], [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action].
